gaps.sentence: The factory has doubled its ___ (PRODUCE) of electric batteries.
gaps.explanation: 'Its production' — the noun for the amount manufactured follows the possessive.

gaps.sentence: The economy shows signs of ___ (RECOVER) after the recession.
The leaflet gives a clear ___ (EXPLAIN) of the rules.
There were three ___ (BURGLE) on our street last month.
gaps.explanation: 'Three burglaries' — plural noun for the crime; burglars are people.
'Studying management' — the field is called management.

gaps.sentence: He was ___ (APPOINT) at the election result.
The instructions have been ___ (SIMPLE) so that children can follow them.
gaps.explanation: Passive 'have been simplified' — the verb form meaning made simpler.

gaps.sentence: His ___ (REFUSE) to cooperate stalled the negotiations.
